name: Zahhak
description: Masked king. Cracked copper-red face mask, tall spiked bone-and-metal crown, long grey-black hair, floor-length black velvet robe. V01 black snakes coiled at shoulders + plain staff; V02 dragon-embroidered robe + old-wood staff; V03 dragon-embroidered robe + cobra staff. Mask, crown and silhouette are constant across all three.

name: Jamshid
description: White mask carved with gold sunburst rosettes, long straight black hair, gold five-point crown, red-and-cream block-print robe over floral lining. Photographed in a pale stone niche.

name: Workers
description: Rough white block masks with protruding peg noses and two drilled eyes. Dyed wool tunics in maroon, olive, teal. Slung stone satchels, wooden digging poles.

name: Craftsmen
description: Block masks with red-clay peg noses. Pink, cream and teal tunics. Carry hand tools, a stone tablet and a basket. Currently exists only inside SHM-REF-001.

name: Fire Priests
description: Long beaked pale masks incised with red sun glyphs, round tasselled side-discs. Red and black layered robes. Hold slender rods and low censers.

name: Royal Warriors
description: Dark green-grey stone block masks with hollow ringed eyes and a heavy carved nose. Hide-and-sackcloth mantles. Long spears, crimson shields with a gold sunburst.

name: Palace Guards
description: Completely featureless pale stone egg-shaped heads, no eyes or mouth. Dark blue-black quilted coats with small dagger loops. Distinct from GRP-004: no carved features, no shields, no spears.

name: Ceremonial Gate - Stone Relief
description: Weathered blue-grey and ochre stone gate, standing horse reliefs on the four flanking slabs, black void doorway, shallow tiered step platform, flat dusk sky.

name: Ceremonial Gate - Cypress Court
description: Tall dark bronze door recessed in a carved sandstone wall, cypresses flanking a stepped ramp, twin stone water channels, warm low sunset light on the stone.

name: Ceremonial Gate - Marble Screen
description: Folded screen of cream and red-veined marble slabs, single tall dark doorway, two rows of cypresses, pale paved approach, near-black storm sky.

name: Mountain Pass
description: Single ochre rock peak rising from an empty rust-coloured plain, pale dirt road winding in from the foreground. Painterly, matte-painting surface texture.

name: Iranian Plateau
description: Late dry season. Grey rocky ridge line across the frame, teal haze sky, rust and sage scrub in the foreground. Establishing wide, no architecture.

name: Hall of Columns
description: Night. Two rows of massive weathered columns, a throne entirely buried under a vast white shroud that pools across the floor, a small gold crown set alone on a plinth beside it, deep blue void beyond the arch.

name: Royal Audience Platform
description: Dark green-black monolithic facade with a torn mountain-like silhouette, tiled pointed-arch doorway, small red-and-gold tiled windows, wide brick step platform, twin pale peaks behind in flat fog.

name: Zahhak Royal Ritual Kitchen
description: Vast low underground vault, pale blue-grey square piers, a small stone hearth with live fire at the far end, the whole floor covered in flower bundles, fruit, grain dishes and dark domed vessels.

name: Ceremonial Reception Hall
description: Wide frontal symmetry. Green-black piers left and right, pale ashlar back wall, low empty stone dais, a row of small oil lamps casting rust stains up the wall, broad tiered steps.

name: Takht-e Jamshid - Throne
description: Small gilded jewelled throne with a rose-and-turquoise back panel, set inside a weathered stone aedicule on a stepped platform, heavy fog rolling across the frame. Hero throne plate.

name: Palace Underlevels
description: Descending secondary circulation. V01 a carved-rock corridor with blue-washed arched niches and one long central stair. V02 a large mudbrick multi-level courtyard with several stairs and small trees. These may be two different places.

name: Staff - Bronze Cobra
description: Twisted dark wood shaft with a bronze hooded cobra head, mouth open, fangs showing. Full turnaround sheet with front, back, head detail and base detail. Carried by CHR-001 in V03.

name: Staff - Plain Old Wood
description: Plain pale weathered wood, no head, slight natural curve, roughly shoulder height. Visible only inside CHR-001 V01 and V02. Deliberately the anti-cobra staff.

name: Diplomatic Gift Set
description: V01 flat-lay on a stone slab: sheathed dagger on black velvet, ornate silver mace, folded crimson gold-thread textiles, black lidded jar, raw crystal, silver casket. V02 staged in a niche: carved stone bird vessel, jewelled textile hanging, tooled belt with gold buckle, gold casket, gold chain.

name: Riding Beast - Pale Beaked
description: Seated. White and pale blue shaggy coat, heavy smooth bone-coloured beak, single short horn, crimson embroidered saddle blanket. Highland scrub setting, dusk.

name: Riding Beast - Long-Beak Black
description: Standing, horse proportions. Black matted dripping coat, very long tapered pale beak, weathered green panel blanket and leather harness. Two small figures in frame for scale. Misty conifer hillside.

name: Riding Beast - Stone Hide
description: Standing, bear-like bulk. Blue lichen-and-stone hide flecked with pale mineral, blunt heavy muzzle, small ears, massive pale splayed claws. Three robed figures for scale on an open plain.

name: Civilization Caste Board
description: 4-up contact sheets. V01 quadrants workers / craftsmen / priests / civilization. V02 quadrants workers / craftsmen / priests / warriors. Source board for GRP-001 through GRP-004.

name: Iranian Nobles
description: Five to eight Iranian nobles and commanders with visible variation between them. Petitioners, not an army: tired irregular spacing, no raised weapons. Masks are smooth continuous human-like surfaces with small eye openings - never skull or skeletal.

name: Iranian Riders
description: Mounted political escort accompanying the delegation. Explicitly not an invading force: no formation, no drawn weapons, harness and travel wear.

name: Jamshid Attendants
description: Jamshid servants and personal guards inside the Hall of Columns. Distinct from GRP-005 palace guards: attendants carry and serve rather than stand post.

name: Approach to Zahhak Domain
description: Cold rocky plain with a distant stone road leading to Zahhak severe stone complex. Wide empty land between converging groups. Overcast, weak crosswind.

name: Zahhak Outer Court
description: Outer courtyard of Zahhak complex where riders and animals wait outside the audience hall.

name: Iran Outskirts
description: Healthy liveable edge of the Iranian city before Zahhak arrives. Partly green, cultivated, intact - deliberately not a post-apocalyptic ruin.

name: Royal Causeway
description: Ascending ramp and stair leading to the seat of power. Built for the rising line of Zahhak entry.

name: Lower Gate - Mount
description: Secondary lower gate where Jamshid mount waits during the escape. Smaller and plainer than the main ceremonial gate.

name: Final Desert
description: Final desert with a fully open horizon and no ridge line. Closing image of the episode.

name: Iranian Royal Banner
description: Official Iranian royal banner. Carried upright by the delegation, then lowered to near-horizontal before Zahhak as a surrendered line.

name: Ritual Vessel
description: Simple stone or metal ritual vessel. Heavy and plain, not treasure - no jewels, coins or decorative glow.

name: Power Insignia
description: Restrained metal insignia of political authority. One of the three limited ceremonial gifts.

name: Jamshid Regalia
description: Royal elements Jamshid can drop during the escape - shed to move faster and to shed the office itself.

name: Mount Harness
description: Entirely functional saddle and harness for the terrestrial mount. Working tack, no ornament.

name: Jamshid Daughters Chamber
description: Warm private chamber of Jamshid household. Pale carved plaster walls with tree reliefs, twin columns topped by carved beasts, scroll shelves, lute, flowering plants, lanterns, large carpet.

name: Jamshid Daughters Passage
description: Transitional passage inside the royal complex, reached after the daughters chamber. Nested stone door frames opening onto rising steps, carved panels and niche reliefs on dark green-black walls, polished floor.

name: Stair Transition Passage
description: Intermediate passage linking the upper royal quarters to Zahhak occupied ceremonial spaces. A single pale winding stair climbing through a dark blue-black cavern, mossy ground.

name: Zahhak Hall Threshold
description: Monumental threshold into Zahhak hall. Towering pale plaster walls, one immense dark opening, a small ember of fire and a tiny figure deep inside, dry weeds at the wall base.

name: Zahhak Hall
description: Vast ceremonial hall of Zahhak. Dark rust-stained walls, a single vertical slit of light above a small stepped dais, scattered standing candles on a wide pale floor.

name: Arnavaz
description: Daughter of Jamshid. Ivory mask carved with gold floral tracery and a dark streak down the right cheek, long straight black hair with blunt fringe, long cream tassel earrings. Slate-blue wool vest embroidered with gold flowers, silver belt, full cream linen blouse and wide gathered trousers, silver cuffs and embossed silver boots.

name: Shahrnaz
description: Daughter of Jamshid. Ivory mask covered in fine gold floral tracery, long straight centre-parted black hair, disc-and-tassel earrings. Quilted cream bib embroidered with dark red rosettes, black puffed sleeves, long layered charcoal tweed skirt, bronze arm cuffs, medallion belt, black boots.

name: Musician
description: Court musician. Tall black velvet hat worn low over the eyes, embroidered with a silver cross motif, long black hair, drop earrings. Long dark brown linen robe with embroidered collar and cuffs, tasselled woven sash, embroidered slippers. Plays a pear-shaped lute, standing or seated on a carved stool.

name: Cat Persian Longhair
description: Long-haired Persian cat, ginger and cream with a white ruff, chest and paws, heavy plumed tail, half-lidded amber eyes. Photographed lying on a carpet-covered bench against a pale plaster wall.

name: Instrument Saz
description: Long-necked pear-shaped lute, about 120 cm. Pale spruce soundboard, ribbed dark rosewood back with light inlay lines, tied gut frets, carved animal-head pegbox with four dark wooden pegs, four strings, tied bridge, black wooden stand. Also seen in the daughters chamber (LOC-020).

name: Dagger Horse Head
description: Ornate straight dagger, about 28 cm. Bronze horse-head pommel with red gem eyes, black cord-wrapped grip between jewelled bronze collars, gem-set crossguard, tapering double-edged blade with pierced bronze filigree and inset red stones down the centre. Worn at the sash with a dark red embroidered robe.

name: Armayel
description: Masked man in a black wool cap and cropped black jacket with four cross-shaped copper fasteners, wide black skirt-trousers and black shoes. Teal ceramic mask painted with cream and coral blossom branches; grey curls at the nape. Episode 15 figure.

name: Garmayel
description: Masked man with a dark wound turban and a pale cracked-clay mask with a long ridged nose and slit eyes. Red and black woven tribal vest over a black tunic and a long brown patterned skirt-robe, black shoes. Grey hair at the nape. Episode 15 figure, sibling of Armayel.

name: Big Brother
description: Young man with black curly hair, a beaded headband and a turquoise cracked-plaster mask embroidered with pearl flowers and borders. Loose patterned grey-brown tunic and balloon trousers, cream ankle boots. The elder of the two brothers in episode 15.

name: Little Brother
description: Child with dark curly hair and a round felted-wool face mask with button eyes, a stitched red smile and a small nose. Navy wool jacket with floral trim at collar, pockets and cuffs, grey corduroy trousers, cream sneakers. The younger brother; the adult look is V02.

name: Head Chef
description: Man with black curly hair and a cream headband tie, wearing a red studded leather mask with metal beads and a floral stud pattern. Blue linen shirt, long cream apron with pockets, loose cream trousers and brown sandals. Episode 15 head chef of the Zahhak kitchen.

name: Zahhak Kitchen Main
description: Large white-tiled industrial kitchen in cold blue light from a ceiling skylight panel. Long central wooden prep table, steel cauldrons and stoves down both sides, extraction hoods, steam, four masked cooks in dark smocks working in silhouette. Wet dark floor.

name: Slaughter Prep Room
description: Cold green-grey stone and marble hall with a central rough-cut stone slab table, steel hooks on overhead rails with hanging carcasses, marble counter on the left, carved pillars at both edges and ceiling light strips.

name: Back Courtyard Transfer
description: Back transfer courtyard of the Zahhak palace at night: a deep stone ruin court with arched bays holding cauldrons and small fires, upper arcades and crenellated galleries, in blue fog. Colonnade, barred window and balustrade views are further looks of it.

name: Back Exit To Plain
description: Outside corner of a colossal dark stone palace wall in blue fog, a tiny low doorway at its foot and a faint amber window high up, rubble and a low stone line leading out onto an open dark plain.

name: Dawn Plain Mountain Foot
description: Wide misty grassland plain at dawn under heavy violet-grey cloud, low dark mountain ridges on the horizon with one pale gap of light, dry grass and scattered dark stones in the foreground.

name: Narrow Escape Passage
description: Near-black rock-cut passage with thick rough pillars and stepped stone bases either side, a faint light far down the narrowing corridor, bare earth floor.

name: Vessel Snake Feeding Tray
description: Long shallow dark-metal oval tray, about 2 m across, with a swan-necked handle at each end shaped as a scaled serpent with its head curled outward. Engraved band of plants and creatures along the inner rim, two shallow wells and a central pedestal with iron spokes. Shown on a black granite plinth.

name: Townsfolk Masked
description: Background townsfolk and minor characters of episode 15, shown one person per look. Each wears a different soft handmade mask (knitted, beaded, felted, wool, carved wood or metal plate) with a plain face, over loose layered everyday clothes in muted wool and linen. No weapons or insignia. Use for crowds, extras and passers-by, never for named characters.

name: Cloak Burlap Grey
description: Escape disguise: one large coarse grey burlap cloth draped over the head and body so that no face or hair shows, pinned at the chest with a small peg and a thin cord. Worn over a dusty grey linen tunic and dark skirt. Worn threadbare with a faint faded leaf pattern along the hem.

name: Cleaver Butcher Wide
description: Oversized butcher cleaver: one very wide, long rectangular blade of dull scratched grey steel, slightly curved along the cutting edge, plain and unadorned, with a short dark round wooden handle set at the top right corner. Shown flat on a dark green-black surface.

name: Zahhak Kitchen Black Tile
description: Vast black-tiled palace kitchen with relief carvings of beasts across the walls, three tall arched niches, stone lion-head plaques, and three white globe lamps hanging from the ceiling. Dark iron ranges with copper-ringed knobs and copper pots in the centre, long prep counters with food to the left, a steel sink run to the right, shelves of copper pans, and a drainage grate across the stone floor.

name: Fugitive Camp Gorge
description: A hidden camp of the fugitives in a narrow fog-filled gorge between two sheer dark cliffs. Rock-cut dwellings and stone arches climb the right slope, cloth awnings and small campfires are scattered across the terraced floor, a bridge crosses far back, and bare trees stand in the foreground. Blue dusk haze.

name: Rescued Survivors
description: The people rescued from the palace, shown as a row standing on grassland under grey sky. Every face is hidden: veils and head cloths in green, maroon, olive, black, white and rust, over embroidered and beaded masks. Long loose robes in faded green, blue, cream, olive and brown. Each look is a different line-up; use for crowd shots of the freed.

name: Zahhak Citadel Distant View
description: Distant elevated view from a cracked rocky ridge across a foggy plain: a grid-planned city with canals and low roofs, and Zahhak's black fortress rising on a rock massif on the right horizon. Blue pre-dawn haze, dark rock in the foreground corners.

name: Vessel Set Brain Prep
description: Table still life of Garmayel's cooking vessels: a large dark metal wok-like pan holding pale brains, dried herbs and red sauce with a ladle, around it engraved copper and dark metal jugs, footed bowls with etched animal figures, bowls of brains and herbs, a flat spatula with a wooden handle, and a few spoons. Dark grey surface.
